name: v0.1.7
body: # PuPu 0.1.7 - Early Preview Release 🚀 v0.1 is a major upgrade focused on chat workflow, architecture cleanup, and product polish. ## Major Functionality PuPu is a desktop AI client built for everyday work with both local and cloud models. It combines chat, tools, memory, workspace context, and runtime management in one streamlined app. - 💬 **Chat and streaming** - Real-time streaming responses with improved visibility during generation. - Trace timeline support for following tool calls and execution flow more clearly. - Better resend flow and more stable long-chat performance. - 📎 **Attachments and input workflow** - Drag-and-drop support for images and PDFs. - Local attachment storage and cleaner attachment display in chat. - Refined chat input and attach panel experience for faster everyday use. - 🧠 **Memory system** - Short-term memory keeps recent conversation context available during a chat. - Long-term memory helps retain reusable facts, preferences, and workflows across chats. - Built-in Memory Inspect and configurable memory settings for better control and visibility. - 🗂️ **Workspace-aware chat** - Add and manage multiple workspaces. - Select workspaces per chat to keep conversations grounded in the right files and folders. - Workspace validation and runtime directory support for a more reliable local workflow. - 🛠️ **Tools and execution** - Tool usage is integrated directly into the chat workflow. - Terminal and workspace-related capabilities are separated more clearly, with workspace actions focused on file-based operations. - Confirmation flow helps prevent accidental tool execution. - 🤖 **Model provider management** - Manage OpenAI and Anthropic API keys directly inside the app. - Browse Ollama models by category, search quickly, and inspect model metadata. - Pull local models with one click, track download progress, and monitor active downloads in real time. - 💾 **Local storage and runtime management** - Inspect app storage usage and manage localStorage entries safely. - Check Ollama status, review installed models, and remove local models when needed. - Inspect runtime file usage under the configured workspace and clean up files when necessary. - 🎨 **Desktop experience** - Native desktop workflow across local models, hosted providers, chat history, settings, and tools. - Updated loading experience, polished UI details, and a more consistent visual system. - In-app update support for faster upgrades. ### New Features in v0.1.7 - summary artifacts ## ⚠️ Known Limitations & Notes - Early Preview Reminder: This is still an early preview release. Some features are incomplete, and edge-case bugs may still exist. ## Bug Fixes - subagent optimizer added - ensure the model to use plan toolkit when selected - subagent frame lazy render to reduce latency - subagent duplicate or nested chat id fixed - compact context menu If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to report them! 🚀 ## What to expect Starting with upcoming releases, PuPu release notes will include a short forward-looking section. The goal is to keep users and watchers aware of the project direction while keeping shipped changes and future work clearly separated. - **Agent Builder** — PuPu is moving toward a visual builder for reusable agents. The direction is to let users define an agent's prompt, model defaults, tool access, and sub-agent pool, then select that agent directly from chat for repeatable workflows. These are roadmap previews, not release commitments. Scope and timing may change as the features are tested in real workflows.

name: v0.1.0
body: # PuPu 0.1.0 - Early Preview Release 🚀 Compared with v0.0.5, v0.1.0 is a major upgrade focused on chat workflow, architecture cleanup, and product polish. ## Major Updates - 💬 **Chat upgrade:** added v2 streaming and trace timeline for better response visibility. - 📎 **Attachment workflow revamped:** supports drag-and-drop, attachment storage, and cleaner display. - 🗂️ **Side menu and workspace improvements:** added search, active node highlighting, and workspace root validation. - 🛠️ **Toolkit and runtime enhancements:** added ToolPicker flow, runtime directory management, and Miso build scripts. - 🎨 **UI/UX polish:** new loading screen, improved input/attach panel styling, and refreshed icon system. - 🏷️ **Branding update:** app metadata and product naming aligned to PuPu. - 📦 **Build process improved:** updated packaging scripts for web + electron + Miso runtime. ### Model Providers The new Model Providers page now includes: - **OpenAI and Anthropic API key management** - Save, update, reveal/hide, and delete keys with confirmation. - Keys are stored locally in your app settings. - **Ollama Model Library browser** - Browse by categories (Embedding, Vision, Tools, Thinking, Code). - Search models with fast, debounced filtering. - View model metadata such as tags, sizes, and pull count. - **One-click model pull workflow** - Select model size, start pull, track real-time progress, and cancel when needed. - Installed models are detected and labeled automatically. - **Active Downloads panel** - Monitor all ongoing Ollama downloads in one place. ### Local Storage The Local Storage page is now split into three practical sections: - **System** - View all localStorage keys, sorted by size. - Check total storage usage. - Delete individual keys or clear all with confirmation. - Special safe reset flow for the settings key. - **Ollama** - Check Ollama status (ready, offline, starting, not installed). - View installed model count and total size. - Reload status, restart Ollama (desktop bridge), and delete local models. - **Runtime** - Inspect runtime directory usage under your configured workspace root. - See per-file/per-folder size breakdown. - Delete individual runtime entries or clear all runtime files. ## ⚠️ Known Limitations & Bug Fixes - Early Version Reminder: This is still an early preview release. Some features are incomplete and edge-case bugs may still exist. - **Known Limitations:** - Some toolkit content is still in Coming Soon state. - Runtime-dependent features may require local Miso setup. ## Bug Fixes: - Fixed RenameRow confirm logic (initial value handling). - Fixed TraceChain details formatting issues. - Fixed inconsistent icon references (hammer → tool). - Fixed multiple chat interaction issues (including scroll/to-bottom behavior stability). If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to report them! 🚀
